author: VANSMITHLAB
title: Lars Müller Publishers
summary: An independent publisher or editorial studio in Baden since 1983. It publishes books on architecture, design, photography, art and society with close attention to editorial content and graphic form as one whole.

hero_image.alt: A wooden book press clamping a stack of folded signatures, beside an open sewn book block, linen thread and bone folders on a worktable.
hero_image.caption: The press and the sewn block: publishing treated as a craft with tolerances, not only as a choice of contents.
